title: Who we are
body:
The Ghost Unit is one of the most prestigious departments within FSRP. From everyday encounters to special
            operations and high-speed pursuits, our troopers exemplify excellence in all facets of law enforcement. Our
            commitment to professionalism and community safety sets us apart.

title: Reduce Speed-Arrive Alive
body:
Within FHP, every trooper carries the responsibility of life itself. From routine patrols to high-risk responses,
            our commitment to vigilance, precision, and professionalism defines who we are. Safety is not just a rule, it is a
            promise we uphold in every decision, every action, and every moment on the road. Our dedication to protecting the
            community is unrivaled, and excellence guides every step we take.

title: Our Sub-Divisions
body: The Ghost Unit is comprised of two specialized subdivisions, each with its own unique focus and operational fields. Whether it's high-speed pursuits or tactical response scenarios, our subdivisions are equipped to handle a variety of law enforcement challenges with expertise.
